onyx.$description: Onyx — Primary text, icons, dark hero backgrounds, footer — the dominant ink color across all UI

paper.$description: Paper — Card surfaces, nav bar, product detail panels, input fields — the lightest surface in the stack

fog.$description: Fog — Page canvas behind card grids and product sections — slightly cool, lower than pure white so product imagery pops

slate.$description: Slate — Muted helper text, disabled states, secondary button borders, input placeholder

graphite.$description: Graphite — Body copy, secondary nav text, descriptions — the workhorse text gray that sits between headlines and helper text

iron.$description: Iron — Primary nav item text, section headings on light backgrounds — darker than body to anchor hierarchy

ash.$description: Ash — Tertiary captions, meta text, fine print

carbon.$description: Carbon — Footer background, dark panels — deep neutral for terminal/closing sections

signal-blue.$description: Signal Blue — Blue supporting accent for decorative details and low-frequency emphasis.

indigo-steel.$description: Indigo Steel — Secondary link state, hover or visited variant of Signal Blue — a muted counterpart that reads as the same brand without competing for attention

open-sans.$description: Primary UI and content typeface across nav, body, headings, and buttons — chosen for its technical/neutral humanist character that pairs well with hardware product imagery; weight 300 on large display sizes with -0.03em tracking creates an engineered, almost aerospace-instrument feel

arial.$description: Arial — detected in extracted data but not described by AI
